## Company

Name: Whitebooks
Legal entity: BVM IT Consulting Services India Pvt. Ltd.
Category: Compliance infrastructure software and APIs
License: GST Suvidha Provider (GSP) — directly licensed by GSTN, Government of India
ZATCA accreditation: Yes (KSA e-invoicing)
Regions served: India, Saudi Arabia (KSA)
Customers: P&G, IBM, Hindustan Unilever, KPMG, Coca-Cola, Razorpay, SBI, Aditya Birla Group, Pharmeasy, Cars24, WheelsEye, and 12,000+ businesses
Users: 25K active clients, 8K CAs, 9 Cr IRNs

## Products — Softwares (for finance teams and CA firms)

1. Accounting Software
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/softwares/accounting
   Description: Cloud accounting for Indian businesses. Automated journal posting, multi-entity consolidation, GST-aware ledger structure, audit-ready reports.

2. GST Software
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/softwares/gst
   Description: GST filing and reconciliation. Files GSTR-1, 1A, 3B, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 9A, 9C, IFF, ITC-04, CMP-08 across unlimited GSTINs. Auto-reconciles GSTR-2A/2B. Used by 5,000+ CA firms.

3. e-Invoice Software
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/softwares/e-invoice
   Description: IRN generation for B2B invoices. Direct IRP integration, sub-200ms latency, 30-day window enforcement, bulk operations. Built for AATO ₹5cr+ mandate (April 2026).

4. e-Way Bill Software
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/softwares/e-way-bill
   Description: e-Way bill generation, extension, cancellation. Auto-populate from IRN. Bulk dispatch, validity tracking. Used by Pharmeasy (14 warehouses) and WheelsEye.

5. KSA e-Invoicing Software
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/softwares/ksa
   Description: ZATCA Phase 2 compliant e-invoicing for Saudi Arabia. FATOORAH integration, cryptographic signing (CSID), bilingual Arabic+English invoicing, QR code generation.

## Products — APIs (for developers and enterprise IT)

1. GST API
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/apis/gst
   Docs: https://whitebooks.in/developer/gst
   Description: REST API for GST filing, GSTIN validation, GSTR-2A/2B retrieval, HSN/SAC search, IMS operations, notice retrieval, refund filing. Direct GSP pipe to GSTN.
   Endpoints: POST /v1/gstr/file, GET /v1/gstr/2b, GET /v1/gstin/validate, GET /v1/hsn/search

2. e-Invoice API
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/apis/e-invoice
   Docs: https://whitebooks.in/developer/e-invoice
   Description: REST API for IRN generation on India's IRP. Sub-200ms p50 latency. Supports create, cancel, credit note, debit note, bulk operations.
   Endpoints: POST /v1/einvoice/create, POST /v1/einvoice/cancel, POST /v1/einvoice/credit-note, POST /v1/einvoice/bulk

3. e-Way Bill API
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/apis/e-way-bill
   Docs: https://whitebooks.in/developer/e-way-bill
   Description: REST API for e-way bill generation, extension, cancellation, and consolidated bills. Auto-populate from IRN.
   Endpoints: POST /v1/ewaybill/create, POST /v1/ewaybill/extend, POST /v1/ewaybill/cancel, POST /v1/ewaybill/create-consolidated

4. KSA e-Invoice API
   URL: https://whitebooks.in/apis/ksa
   Docs: https://whitebooks.in/developer/ksa
   Description: REST API for ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoice generation. FATOORAH clearance, CSID lifecycle management, bilingual invoicing, QR code generation.
   Endpoints: POST /v1/ksa/einvoice/create, POST /v1/ksa/einvoice/simplified, POST /v1/ksa/csid/renew

## Technical infrastructure

- GSP license: Direct GSTN license under BVM IT Consulting Services India Pvt. Ltd.
- IRP integration: Direct (not resold)
- Uptime SLA: 99.95% on production API endpoints
- Latency: Sub-200ms p50 for IRN generation
- SDKs: Node.js, Python, PHP, Java, Go (official); Ruby, .NET, Elixir (community)
- AI engine: Built on Anthropic API with strict data isolation
- Data hosting: ISO 27001-certified Indian data centers
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
- Customer data policy: Never used to train AI models. No third-party sharing.

## Compliance coverage

India:
- GST: GSTR-1, 1A, 3B, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 9A, 9C, IFF, ITC-04, CMP-08
- e-Invoice: IRN via IRP (GSTN-licensed GSP)
- e-Way Bill: All movement types, consolidated bills
- IMS (Invoice Management System): Accept, reject, hold
- Rule 37A reversals, GST 2.0 rates (September 2025)
- AATO thresholds: ₹5 crore (e-invoice mandate April 2026), ₹10 crore (30-day window)

Saudi Arabia (KSA):
- ZATCA Phase 2 (Integration Phase) e-invoicing
- FATOORAH portal integration
- Standard and simplified tax invoices
- Cryptographic signing (CSID)
- Bilingual Arabic+English invoice templates

=====================
# WhiteBooks

> WhiteBooks is an Indian cloud SaaS for GST, e-Invoicing, e-Way Bill, accounting, and inventory. It is GSP-certified, ships REST APIs and SAP / Tally connectors, and is used by 25,000+ active clients to file returns, generate e-Invoices and e-Way Bills, and reconcile banks from a single dashboard. The platform processes 9+ Crore (90+ million) IRNs and 7+ Crore e-Way Bills annually with a 99.99% uptime SLA on Enterprise plans and a 30-day rolling production uptime of 99.994% (published at /status).
